query.description: The search query text. Pass only the query, not a question.

connection_string.description: Couchbase connection string (e.g. couchbase://localhost). Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

username.description: Couchbase username. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

password.description: Couchbase password. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

embedding_key.description: Field name in the FTS index that stores the vector

scoped_index.description: Whether the FTS index is scoped
